payload.title: No service holds a publish grant on the dead-letter subject (dlq.<tenant>.<type>), so every dead-letter is refused with a Permissions Violation and the original is NAK'd instead: a poison message is redelivered for its whole delivery budget
evidence: infrastructure/nats/services.yaml:1 (no publish grant matching dlq.*; only dlq_replayer subscribes dlq.>)
platform/libs/event-bus/src/nats/nats-event-bus.ts:1596 (jetStream.publish to dlqSubjectFor, with the service's own identity)
payload.rule_violated: Every service that runs JetStream consumers may dead-letter; the grant is exactly dlq.*.* (ADR-014/015 least privilege)
payload.notes: Fixed in services.yaml + regenerated nats.conf (NATS reload on deploy) + two invariants in nats-invariants.spec.ts; proven against a real nats-server 2.10.24 (refused before, accepted after).
narrative: Production 2026-10-26: aqua-alert and aqua-notification log 'DLQ publish FAILED ... Permissions Violation for Publish to "dlq.<tenant>.<type>"' (original NAK'd, not finished into loss).
